problem_text:
A logistics manager is selecting cargo containers to load onto a freight truck. Available containers are:

* Container 1: weight 46kg, revenue 228 credits
* Container 2: weight 11kg, revenue 133 credits
* Container 3: weight 46kg, revenue 267 credits
* Container 4: weight 45kg, revenue 294 credits
* Container 5: weight 38kg, revenue 95 credits
* Container 6: weight 30kg, revenue 206 credits
* Container 7: weight 13kg, revenue 37 credits
* Container 8: weight 34kg, revenue 228 credits
* Container 9: weight 37kg, revenue 262 credits
* Container 10: weight 10kg, revenue 218 credits
* Container 11: weight 40kg, revenue 273 credits
* Container 12: weight 33kg, revenue 49 credits
* Container 13: weight 12kg, revenue 96 credits
* Container 14: weight 21kg, revenue 92 credits
* Container 15: weight 40kg, revenue 220 credits
* Container 16: weight 24kg, revenue 226 credits
* Container 17: weight 43kg, revenue 223 credits
* Container 18: weight 19kg, revenue 115 credits
* Container 19: weight 26kg, revenue 218 credits
* Container 20: weight 38kg, revenue 223 credits
* Container 21: weight 33kg, revenue 124 credits
* Container 22: weight 47kg, revenue 245 credits
* Container 23: weight 6kg, revenue 15 credits
* Container 24: weight 44kg, revenue 253 credits
* Container 25: weight 34kg, revenue 28 credits
* Container 26: weight 21kg, revenue 182 credits
* Container 27: weight 50kg, revenue 176 credits
* Container 28: weight 31kg, revenue 154 credits
* Container 29: weight 49kg, revenue 281 credits

The truck has a maximum load capacity of 644 kg. Choose the combination of containers that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this weight limit. Each container must be either fully loaded or left behind.
